title: Artesian Well Site Assessment Data
description: A dataset capturing geospatial, structural, usage, and management characteristics of artesian well sites.

title: Basic Sanitation Information System - BaSIS
description: This package compiles sanitation data from established Open Defecation Free (ODF) communities across different regions in Ghana.

title: Data for 61 semi-structured interviews with biogas owners in Malawi
description: This dataset consists of 61 semi-structured interviews with biogas owners in the Southern Region of Malawi. Interviews were conducted over multiple visits to sites over the course of a two-year period between June 2021 and October 2022.
authors: Lars Sch<U+00F6>bitz; Sebastian Camilo Loos; Marc Kalina; Jonathan Olal Ogwang; Jonathan Kwangulero; Elizabeth Tilley

title: Borehole Forensics 4 - Pumping Test Data 2018-2024
description: This dataset contains borehole forensic pumping test data, capturing key parameters related to groundwater extraction, borehole performance, and water quality assessments. It includes information on the test conditions, water levels, pumping rates, flow measurement methods, and water quality indicators such as pH, turbidity, and electrical conductivity. The dataset also documents permissions granted for testing, equipment used, and observations on borehole performance.
authors: Emmanuel Mhango; Finlay Paterson; Paul Kumpukwe

title: Analysis of boreholes' functionality in Northern Malawi
description: The data is obtained from a survey conducted in Wasambo in Karonga district (Northen Malawi). This data is about boreholes and handpumps that people mostly rely on for drinking water, secondary to wells and rivers. The data were collected in June 2023.
authors: Mabvuto Yesaya; Juliette Preisig; Hastings Kayira; Mian Zhong

title: Water Quality Laboratory Analysis and Reporting Dataset <U+2013> Malawi (2017<U+2013>2019)
description: This dataset contains comprehensive records of water quality test results collected from various water points across Malawi between 2017 and 2019
authors: Emmanuel Mhango; Finlay Paterson; Jamie Rattray

title: Dataset about experiments of field application of breathable laminate-lined pit latrines
description: This dataset assists with a research study aims at capturing the pathogens and contaminants from pit latrines by lining them with a hydrophobic laminate. The data are collected to demonstrate the transport of contaminants from two pour flush, twin-pit latrines in which one pit is lined and one is unlined.

title: Data for a sanitation zoning assessment done for Cap Haitien, Haiti
description: This package contains data for a sanitation zoning assessment done for the city of Cap Haitien, Haiti. It combines two datasets used for an analysis of the suitability of container-based sanitation (CBS).
authors: Sebastian Camilo Loos; Sasha Kramer; Maya Lubeck-Schricker

title: Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices (KAP) Survey about Community Health Centers (CHC) in Malawi
description: This dataset captures insights from a Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices (KAP) Survey conducted by BASEflow for Waste Advisers in Malawi, focusing on Community Health Centers (CHCs). It covers diverse aspects including household demographics, CHC membership, water sources, sanitation, nutrition knowledge, hygiene practices, and environmental conditions.
authors: Sophia Skorik; Lars Sch<U+00F6>bitz; Rhodrick Sagawa; Paul Kumpukwe; Veronica Chinangwa; Baleke Banda; Rodney Kananji; Feston Bwanyula; Gloria Maliana; Given Ngwira

title: Tracks the progress of Cholera epidemic in Malawi (2022-23)
description: A dataset that tracks the progress of the cholera epidemic in each district of Malawi in 2022-23.

title: Clean Team Ghana
description: This package compiles user experience data for the Clean Team Ghana container-based sanitation service in Kumasi, Ghana.
authors: Sophia Skorik; James Benjamin Tidwell; Kwabena Biritwum Nyarko; Ian Ross; Bismark Dwumfour-Asare; Scott Pippa

title: Climate Vulnerability Data in Rural Cambodia
description: Data on Effects of Climate Vulnerability on Sanitation Access, Sanitation Infrastructure Functionality and Households<U+2019> Fecal Sludge Management Practices in Rural Cambodia.

title: Household Latrine Survey Data from Dowa and Thyolo, Malawi
description: Contains survey data collected in October 2020 from households in Dowa and Thyolo Districts, Malawi. The dataset includes detailed information on household sanitation practices, latrine infrastructure, usage patterns, maintenance behaviors, and user preferences across rural and peri-urban communities. Data was collected using the mWater survey platform by BASEflow Malawi enumerators.

title: ODF Sanitation and Hygiene Household Survey <U+2013> Ntchisi & Dowa District 2019
description: This dataset contains results from a household-level WASH (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene) survey conducted on July 1st, 2019 in Mduku GVH, Dowa District, within the catchment area of Mbingwa Health Centre, Malawi. The purpose of the survey was to assess sanitation infrastructure, hygiene practices, and menstrual hygiene management (MHM) as part of an Open Defecation Free (ODF) verification exercise.

title: Borehole Drilling and Construction Data <U+2013> Malawi, 2018 - 2024
description: This dataset captures detailed information on borehole drilling and construction activities conducted across selected sites in Malawi in 2018. Data were collected using the mWater digital platform, documenting each stage of groundwater development, from site selection and hydrogeological studies to drilling operations, borehole design, and post-construction assessments.
authors: Emmanuel Mhango; Jamie Rattray; Shaun MacLeod; Feston Bwanyula

title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
description: What the package does (one paragraph).

title: DS4OWD Analytics
description: Data collected from the Data Science for Open WASH Data (DS4OWD) course and the associated website and data publishing endeavour.

title: USAID Flood Response Rehabilitation and Chlorination Survey
description: This R package provides tools for analyzing and visualizing data from the USAID Flood Response Rehabilitation and Chlorination Survey conducted in Mulanje, Malawi (2019<U+2013>2020). It includes functions to assess handpump component replacements, evaluate changes in functionality before and after rehabilitation, and identify common repair trends using mWater-collected data.

title: Water Point Assessments - USAID Flood Response Malawi 2019-2020
description: Field-level data on rural water point status and functionality across Malawi, collected during the USAID Flood Response initiative (2019-2020). Includes GPS locations, flood impact indicators, pump functionality, water quality measurements, and microbial contamination data from mWater mobile assessments.

title: Data on Faecal Sludge Transporting Logistics in Kampala, Uganda
description: Contains two data resources. `trips` contains the GPS locations of faecal sludge emptying trucks collecting sludge from pit latrines and septic tanks in Kampala, Uganda. Each trip is recorded with a unique identifier, the numberplate of the truck, the date and time of the record. Data was collected from 30th March 2015 until 25th June 2015. `trucks` has additional information on the volume of each truck.

title: Global Faecal Sludge Emptying Services Demand
description: Global faecal sludge emptying demand data for 175 countries. Demand is quantified by population size receiving one of four emptying methods (mechanized, non-mechanized, unemptiable, no facility). The demand is disaggregated by rural and urban percentages of population.
authors: Nicola Greene; Sarah Hennessy; Tate W. Rogers; Jocelyn Tsai; Francis L. de los Reyes III; Lars Sch<U+00F6>bitz

title: Global Database of Humanitarian Organizations
description: A dataset of global humanitarian organizations collected by Humanitarian Outcomes.
authors: Mian Zhong; Abby Stoddard; Tichakunda Mangono

title: Complete Data from the Global Analysis and Assessment of Sanitation and Drinking-Water (GLAAS)
description: An R data package providing comprehensive access to the UN-Water Global Analysis and Assessment of Sanitation and Drinking-water (GLAAS) dataset. The WHO GLAAS survey collects data on water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) systems, policies, and financing from countries worldwide.
authors: Nicol<U+00F2> Massari; Colin Walder; Adriana Clavijo Daza

title: WHO Glossary
description: This package provides access to a tidy version of the WHO Glossary (https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240105485) and thematic areas for each term.

title: Groundwater analysis from 2016 in Kwale, Kenya
description: "The goal of `grdwtrsmpkwale` is to provide datasets for research and planning of water and solid waste management in Kwale, Kenya. This package includes water anlaysis data collected in 2016 combined with the geospatial data from the collection points."
authors: Sebastian Camilo Loos; Mian Zhong; Rob Hope

title: Chiradzulu Handpump Functionality Verification Survey
description: This dataset contains detailed field survey records of borehole and handpump functionality verification exercises conducted in Chiradzulu District, Malawi in February 2020.

title: Hydrogeological Dynamics Data in Ghana
description: This package contains data on boreholes collected to study the hydrogeological dynamics in the greater Accra and Ashanti regions of Ghana.
authors: Benedict Addae-Mensah; Elizabeth Tilley; Adriana Clavijo Daza

title: Malawi Emergency Flood Response Water Point Survey (2019<U+2013>2020)
description: This dataset contains water point assessment data collected during an emergency flood response in Malawi between 2019 and 2020. The survey was conducted under the BASEflow program to evaluate the status, functionality, and safety of water points affected by flooding events.

title: Malawi Groundwater Monitoring Time-Series Dataset (2024<U+2013>2025)
description: This dataset contains groundwater monitoring data collected from monitoring wells across 10 districts in Malawi between 2024 and 2025. The data were captured using automated data loggers installed in monitoring wells and were collected and managed by BASEflow. The dataset provides time-series measurements of key groundwater parameters, enabling detailed analysis of aquifer behavior across multiple geographic locations.

title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
description: What the package does (one paragraph).

title: Planetary Pressures Adjusted Human Development Index Data
description: Provides data on Planetary Pressures Adjusted Human Development, adjusted by carbon emissions per capita (production related) and materials footprint per capita.

title: Data on Publications in PLOS Water Journal
description: Provides access to publishing trends from PLOS Water Journal.

title: A Preliminary Review of Peruvian Potable Water System Data
description: Data to gain preliminary understanding of community potable water systems in Peru.
authors: Lauren Judah; Sebastian Camilo Loos; Mian Zhong

title: USAID Flood Response Post Intervention Survey Data
description: Post-intervention monitoring data for rural water points in the Mulanje district of Malawi, collected as part of the USAID Flood Response program during 2019-2020. The dataset includes comprehensive water point assessments covering physical condition, operational performance, hydraulic measurements, water quality parameters, and microbiological quality assessments.

title: Water point functionality assessment in nine sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia countries
description: Water point monitoring data associated with the paper "[Rural water point functionality estimates and associations: evidence from nine countries in sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia](https://agupubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1029/2023WR034679)" (Murray, Anna L et al., 2024).
authors: Margaux G<U+00F6>tschmann; Anna L. Murray; Gabriela Stone; Audrey R. Yang; Nicholas F. Lawrence; Hannah Matthews; Georgia L. Kayser

title: Data About Behavior and Practices of Managing Sanitation Facilties in Abidjan, Cote d<U+2019>Ivoire
description: This data package contains household survey data collected from two low-income areas of Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire. The survey was focusing on practices related to the management of sanitation facilities, specifically, latrines and tanks.
authors: Phaniwa Zi<U+00E9> Zoumana Coulibaly; Kouassi Dongo; Mian Zhong

title: WASH and Sanitation Survey in Community-Based Childcare Centres <U+2013> Thyolo and Chikwawa, Malawi (2021)
description: This dataset provides detailed information on Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) conditions and related management practices in Community-Based Childcare Centres (CBCCs) across Thyolo and Chikwawa Districts in Malawi, collected in 2021. Data were gathered by BASEflow using the mWater digital data collection platform..

title: Borehole repair data from central Uganda
description: Data set about borehole repair records from the borehole operation and maintenance company operating in central Uganda. Population data is picked as an interview from a representative of the Local Water User Committees (LWUCs). The data on the technical specifications about the borehole is picked from the borehole records file from the company.

title: UNDP Composite Indicators Timeseries
description: Provides tidy data about all UNDP indicators in a composite timeseries.

title: WASH Data From Refugee Camps and Settlements (UNHCR)
description: This is a dataset on WASH indicators in refugee camps and settlements. The data was collected from the UNHCR Information Management System (IRIS) and was available on the UNHCR WASH dashboard. This dataset includes data from 227 sites and 36 countries. The source dashboard has since been retired and the data now sits behind the login-gated iRHIS portal, so this dataset is a fixed historical snapshot (2013 to 2024) that can no longer be regenerated.

title: University Ranking Africa
description: Data from institutional and national levels was combined into a dataset to provide a comprehensive characterization of the top ranked Universities of every African country. This was done to demonstrate the correlation of certain attributes with the academic ranking performance. The dataset also highlights the difficulties of accessing data from many African Universities online.

title: WASH in Schools in Piracema, Brazil
description: The main goal of this study was to describe the profile of schools from the basic education system in the municipality of Piracema (Minas Gerais, Brazil). Moreover, we also aimed to compare the characteristics of schools, with a special concern to WASH, pre- (2020), peri- (2021) and post-COVID-19 pandemic (2022) to evaluate to what extend schools in Piracema made progress in providing WASH since the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic. This study is a sub-project of a PhD project and an initial study comparing the BNSC from 2020 and 2021 has already been conducted and published by the author of this project (for more details see references). Findings will be essential for the next phase of the research, which will be the collection of primary data in schools in the municipality of Piracema through qualitative methods (interviews, on-spot observations and art-based research).
authors: Alexis Tabin; Kasandra Poague; Mian Zhong

title: Multilateral development banks investment behaviour in water and sanitation
description: Dataset on multilateral development bank (MDB) investment in water supply and sanitation between 1960 and 2020 compiled by drawing on on 3,639 water and sanitation projects to assess territorial trends, technology choices, distribution of financial burdens, and reforms to institutional arrangements.
authors: Margaux G<U+00F6>tschmann; Andri Heidler; Muhil Nesi; Josiane Nikiema; Christoph L<U+00FC>thi

title: WASH Household Level Survey Data 2018 - 2023
description: This package provides access to Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) household-level survey data collected in Malawi between 2018 and 2023. The dataset includes comprehensive indicators for monitoring WASH-related Sustainable Development Goals at the household level.
authors: Emmanuel Mhango; Donald Robertson; Chifundo Mandala; M Nzengo; Muthi Nhlema; M. Banda; Khumbo Zinyongo; Christian Nedi; Leman Ngwena; M Kazembe; Yankho Mthindi; E. title: Dataset about open research data information in Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene
description: The goal of washopenresearch is to provide an overview of open research data related to Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH). The package provides access to two datasets `washdev` and `uncnewsletter`. Each dataset collects information on scientific articles about (1) article metadata (e.g. title, first author, correspondence author), (2) supplementary material information, (3) data availability statement, and (4) semantic information (e.g. keywords).
authors: Mian Zhong; Ludwig Luz; Lars Sch<U+00F6>bitz

description: What the package does (one paragraph).

title: Locations of Public Waste Skips in Blantyre, Malawi
description: An R data package containing the locations of public waste skips in Blantyre, Malawi.
authors: Mabvuto Yesaya; Limbani Msuku; Elizabeth Tilley; Sebastian Camilo Loos

title: Household Water Point Satisfaction Survey Data from Malawi
description: Provides household-level survey data on water access, reliability, and user satisfaction from Zomba and Mangochi Districts in Malawi. Collected in September 2021 using GPS-enabled devices, the dataset includes 423 households with information on water sources, infrastructure conditions, seasonal availability, and demographic indicators relevant to water access and decision-making.

title: Household water costs and coping strategies data from metropolitan Accra
description: A household survey on water costs and coping strategies as well as a water point survey were conducted in two low-income communities in metropolitan Accra. These are Korle Gonno, a larger, well-planned coastal area with over 35 household water vendors, and Abuja, a small, densely packed, extralegal settlement with 15 water vendor and bathhouse businesses.
authors: Elizabeth Vicario; Margaux G<U+00F6>tschmann; Betty Avanu Davidson; Ebenezer F. Amankwaa; Mian Zhong

title: Water Point Functionality and Service Delivery Monitoring Dataset - 2023
description: This dataset contains structured field survey responses collected from water point inspections and interviews with community members or water point committee representatives. Each record represents a single survey event linked to a specific water point, including GPS coordinates, enumerator metadata, timestamps, and detailed observations on infrastructure condition, functionality, water availability, maintenance practices, and governance arrangements.

title: Weekly volume of water pumped for handpumps monitored with Smart Handpump technology, Kwale County, Kenya
description: A dataset contains a summary of the weekly volumetric output of pumps monitored using Smart Handpump sensors for 2014 and 2015 in Kwale County of Kenya.
authors: Patrick Thomson; Rob Hope; Tim Foster; Mian Zhong

title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
description: What the package does (one paragraph).

title: Human Development Index Worldwide 1990-2022 (2024)
description: This package provides details about Human Development Index across the world from 1990 to 2022. 193 countries are included in the dataset. It also includes data aggregated by regions.

title: Wastewater management and household infrastructure in Brazil
description: This dataset about wastewater management and household infrastructure from various Brazilian regions provides insights into wastewater disposal habits, water sources, bathroom facilities, and sanitation infrastructure.
